_about: 20 caller questions for Sunshine Dental (practice 4), written before the KB docs existed and phrased the way patients ask, not the way the docs are worded. A hit: one of the top-k chunks comes from an expected doc AND contains every string in that expectation (case-insensitive, dashes normalized). Several questions deliberately share no keywords with their answer (Invisalign, put me to sleep, installments): that's what semantic search is for.
